# Persona: customer

Focus
- What a user sees and gets: popup and settings text, defaults, toasts, error wording.
- Export fidelity: does the exported Markdown/PDF/DOCX match what was on screen
  (message order, roles, code blocks, footnotes, front matter)?
- i18n: new or changed keys exist in every locale under `_locales/` (26 locales, key sets must match).
- README and CHANGELOG claims that no longer match behaviour.
- Anything that changes behaviour for existing users without a mention in the CHANGELOG.

Do not comment on: internal structure, performance, test code, workflow files.
